claims: Mark Byington is the head men's basketball coach at Vanderbilt University.
Mark Byington was hired on March 25, 2024.
Mark Byington was hired to replace Jerry Stackhouse.
Mark Byington led the team to the NCAA Tournament in his second season (2025–26).
Shea Ralph is the head coach for the Vanderbilt women's basketball team.
Mark Byington was formerly the head coach at James Madison from 2020–2024.
Mark Byington had a 32-4 record in his final season at James Madison.
Mark Byington previously coached at Georgia Southern.
Mark Byington held roles at Virginia Tech.
Mark Byington held roles at College of Charleston.
Shea Ralph was hired in 2021 to lead the Vanderbilt women's basketball program.
Shea Ralph was formerly a longtime assistant coach at UConn.
Jerry Stackhouse served as head coach from 2019–2024.
